$comment: CPE-1594 ratchet, made CASE-granular by CPE-1677. Each entry is ONE test case (`spec` = the spec file's basename, `test` = the it() title, verbatim) that is ALLOWED to fail today. Any OTHER case failing reds the job — including a case inside a spec file that already has entries here, which is exactly the hole CPE-1677 closed (whole-file exemptions meant the other 24 cases in samples.smoke.ts guarded nothing). Removing an entry is one-way: once a listed case passes, the ratchet FAILS until its entry is deleted. A listed `test` that matches NO case in the run also FAILS (titles drift; a rename must not silently drop both the exemption and the coverage). Entries are exact titles, never patterns — a pattern would re-create the blanket exemption this replaced. See gui-smoke/README.md 'The ratchet' for the retire procedure.

cases.test: clicking the entry point opens the add-connection popover with its expected fields, and Escape closes it
cases.reason: Cascades from this spec's other listed case (the section-header one): with the Network section never confirmed rendered, the entry-point click lands on whatever is on top and WebKitGTK returns 'element click intercepted' (run 31602466829). Expected to clear at the same time as the CPE-1595 getText() quirk — retire both entries together.

cases.test: the permanent Network section renders with its empty-state '+ Add a connection' row on a fresh app process
cases.reason: CPE-1595 CONFIRMED (not a theory): the `.fav-title` + getText() selector is correct and the header DOES paint — run-31449236678's failure screenshot (network-fail.png) shows 'Network' rendered, visible, on-screen at the exact moment the 15s wait timed out. getText() nonetheless returned something other than 'Network' for every retry in that window. Same WebKitGTK/Xvfb classic-WebDriver GetElementText quirk as saved-search.smoke.ts (CPE-1507) for this Sidebar.svelte '<span class="label fav-title">' header shape — not a rendering gap, not a selector bug (Sidebar.test.ts's jsdom render passes), not fixable by another selector change. Left listed pending a WebKitGTK-specific investigation.
